steps.action: Create a PostgreSQL profile; choose a synthetic CA file and set explicit policy. Save, edit, Save and Connect, disconnect, then delete. Repeat for MySQL.
Create two profiles and three SQL tabs. Reorder tabs, select the middle tab/profile, restart, then remove the first profile.
assertions: selection follows stable identity rather than vector position.

steps.action: Create a new profile without touching policy. Reload an existing development/readonly profile; import each explicit environment/readonly pair and a legacy record.
assertions: New product profile is unspecified/readOnly=false and verify-full TLS.

steps.action: Save a profile with a synthetic password, update it with keep/empty/replacement states, inject metadata failure, then inject credential delete and rollback failures.
assertions: metadata failure restores the prior credential.
no password is written to JSON or diagnostics.

steps.action: Load legacy, corrupt and future-version library fixtures; attempt edits after failed load; inject an atomic-replace failure.
assertions: Legacy exact-byte backup and IDs survive.
failed saves preserve the prior library and selected identity.

steps.action: Export both synthetic engine profiles. Inspect JSON, import v2 and v1, preview/select one and all, cancel once, then complete import. Try secret/unknown/duplicate keys and excessive depth/count/size.
assertions: accepted imports have fresh IDs and stay disconnected.

steps.action: Export a profile referencing a local CA; import on the other OS with the file missing. Remap using its native chooser, then roundtrip back to Mac. Cancel the remap once.
assertions: POSIX/Windows path hints do not become invalid trusted paths.

steps.action: Launch ordinarily with an unreadable/blocking stdin. Launch --connect-stdin with one synthetic payload; test 64 KiB overflow, five-second timeout and retry after failure.
assertions: explicit launch connects once and executes no SQL.

steps.action: Connect two SQL tabs on each engine. BEGIN/create temporary state/SET in A; query temporary state and transaction status in B; run both concurrently and disconnect only B.
assertions: Physical sessions and state stay independent.
the active tab/profile cannot redirect a completion.
A and catalog remain connected after B closes.

steps.action: BEGIN in SQL tab A, then browse catalog and request completion metadata. Stage and Apply a synthetic table edit. Inspect helper sessions.
assertions: Apply uses a fresh idle session.
A remains uncommitted with its original SET/temp state.

steps.action: Execute a query larger than row/byte/result-set display bounds, hold chunk ACKs, request Stop under backpressure, and kill the owned helper in a second run.
assertions: control messages and terminal delivery remain responsive.
partial completed results and authoritative transaction state survive.

steps.action: Close a tab, profile, window and application with idle, open and failed transactions. Cancel, Roll Back and Commit independently; repeat Quit during commit/disconnect.
assertions: repeated Quit keeps the same decision.
process exits only after acknowledged disconnect.

steps.action: Close while a query runs, while inline edit/draft exists, during export and after unknown Apply. Choose Stop and Continue, Apply/Discard/Cancel as available.
assertions: each close scope resolves all affected work.

steps.action: Paste Unicode/CRLF and literal straight quotes/dashes into two SQL tabs. Set different caret/selection/scroll, edit and Undo in both; switch tabs and themes.
assertions: each tab retains independent editing and Undo state.

steps.action: For each SQL corpus case, run a selection, caret statement (including just after semicolon), and entire script; invoke from toolbar/menu/keyboard and Run to File.
assertions: One resolver chooses the same original range for all entry points.
highlights and summary identify exact source.

steps.action: Execute parser corpus including PostgreSQL nested/dollar/atomic routines, MySQL DELIMITER, quoted/comment delimiters, malformed lexemes and rejected client commands.
assertions: Only server statements are sent in order.
unsupported client commands and unterminated lexemes block execution with source diagnostics.

steps.action: Review a mixed script containing allowed/write/destructive/unknown operations. Approve once, then edit SQL, Stop, switch profile or force an error before remaining work.
assertions: Review covers the exact ordered batch even if individual operations classify allowed.

steps.action: Execute success, first-error and middle-error scripts plus MySQL fixture_procedure multi-results. Switch tabs while results arrive.
assertions: Statements run sequentially until first error.

steps.action: Fail the second selected statement after non-BMP text and CRLF; navigate to error, correct it, rerun successfully, then edit the successful source.
assertions: Error and success gutter positions use original UTF-16 source.

steps.action: Open UTF-8 files with non-BMP/combining paths and CRLF, edit/save/save-as in two documents; cancel chooser and test invalid UTF-8/locked destination.
assertions: Each tab retains its own file binding.
exact SQL and line endings survive.
cancellation/write failure leaves original binding/content/destination intact.

steps.action: Edit a draft, wait one second, close/restart and force flush at shutdown; inspect snapshot and test corrupt/future versions.
Execute a three-statement script and failed/cancelled variants; inspect history, reopen entry, exceed 1000 entries/30 days, disable, clear history and drafts, restart.
assertions: History is per statement with bounded retention.
reopening restores source without connecting or execution.

steps.action: Connect both fixtures; lazily expand schemas/table/view/function/procedure/trigger and detail groups; inject failure, retry and Refresh.
assertions: Every supported object/detail kind appears once.
refresh replaces removed metadata without cross-profile mixing.

steps.action: Search for an unexpanded synthetic object across two connected profiles; clear/change search during asynchronous replies.
assertions: Search goes to the server independently of prior expansion.
stale/profile-mismatched replies cannot replace current matches.

steps.action: Invoke Structure, Definition, Open Data, Generate SELECT and Copy Name on table/view/routine with spaces/non-BMP names, using mouse and context-menu keyboard.
assertions: generated SQL opens without implicit execution.

steps.action: Open the fixture table with over 1000 rows, page at 200 rows, sort tied values, then apply all nine typed filter operators including NULL and clear filters.
Run duplicate-name/NULL/empty/literal NULL/exact numeric/binary query and routine multi-sets; exceed 1000 rows and 8 MiB; fail a later set.
assertions: prior sets and partial error remain available.

steps.action: Select a cell, rectangle and sparse whole rows. Copy from keyboard/context menu; inspect TSV plus typed clipboard JSON, including duplicate names and all special values.
assertions: Only intended cells/rows copy in source order.
JSON retains ordinals and typed NULL/binary.

steps.action: Load the 1000x32 grid, resize columns, select rows, scroll vertically/horizontally, switch away/back and change theme/DPI; inspect focus and row numbers.
Open row inspector for NULL, empty, literal NULL, multiline, 1 MiB text and binary; toggle inspector and inspect editable/read-only reasons.
assertions: Large/binary data is bounded and accurate.
edit affordances and explanations follow adapter metadata.

steps.action: Edit fixture nullable/default/text/numeric/binary cells; try generated, no-PK, view, restricted-privilege and MyISAM data.
assertions: unsupported cells explain why and cannot silently change values.

steps.action: Stage insert/update/delete, inspect original values/markers/counts/Columns, edit a value back to original, delete an inserted row, then Discard.
assertions: exact original snapshots and counts stay coherent.
reverting/discard restores content and selection safely.

steps.action: Stage a mixed immutable batch; Preview and review helper-generated parameterized SQL; mutate draft/context while preview reply is delayed.
assertions: Preview uses exact captured typed batch.
stale preview cannot authorize changed work.

steps.action: Keep a SQL tab transaction open; Preview/Apply in grid, attempt edits/navigation/profile mutation while snapshot locked, then deliver stale reply.
assertions: Apply owns a fresh idle session.
locked snapshot/context is revalidated and stale completion rejected.

steps.action: Apply a multi-row batch; use an observer to modify original rows or constraints/metadata; test deadlock and Stop during Apply.
assertions: All writes commit atomically or roll back.

steps.action: Inject lost COMMIT ACK for SQL and Apply. Try retry/reapply, close, explicit verification via independent observer, then discard/reload.
assertions: Outcome stays unknown until explicitly resolved.
close preserves the uncertainty and recovery path.

steps.action: Capture a truncated loaded result, start Export Loaded, then switch tabs/replace results; inspect helper request count.
assertions: Export uses captured rows/metadata and discloses truncation.

steps.action: Export shared grid to JSON and CSV with default NULL marker, then choose collision-free marker; inspect Unicode/CRLF/binary/numeric/duplicate-column content.
assertions: JSON uses ordered metadata/value arrays and exact strings.
CSV rejects marker collisions and quotes correctly.

steps.action: Run to File once on the over-limit query and multi-result routine; test JSON/CSV, Stop, first/middle errors and locked replacement.
assertions: Full rows export independently of display limit.
JSON supports multi-set and CSV rejects ambiguity.
failed/cancelled export never publishes partial output.

steps.action: Start offline completion with no DB; fragment/coalesce Content-Length frames, overflow/truncate, timeout/kill/restart the separate LSP process; inspect inherited environment.
assertions: LSP is separate from DB helper sessions, bounded and sanitized.

steps.action: Explicitly connect each fixture, paginate completion metadata, Refresh after adding/removing an object, then switch profiles during delayed metadata replies.
assertions: Metadata loads only after explicit connect through service session.
stale entries/replies are replaced without leakage.

steps.action: Run shared completion fixtures for CTE/subquery/correlated/LATERAL/alias/projection/ambiguous columns and FK JOIN/ON; inspect ranking and fuzzy UTF-16 highlights.
assertions: Scope-correct suggestions, quoting, ranking, abbreviation/typo matching and highlighted spans match the Go oracle for both dialects.

steps.action: Type and manually invoke completion, navigate/accept with Tab and Return, dismiss Escape, Undo once; repeat in literal/comment and IME composition and with delayed stale replies.
assertions: Popup appears only in valid context.
insertion quotes safely and is one Undo.

steps.action: Run all shared signature cases including nested/SUBSTRING/named/default/variadic/overload/Unicode; type/change caret/Escape/Undo, refresh connected routine metadata and switch theme/DPI.
assertions: Correct function/overload/active UTF-16 parameter and return type display.
offline built-ins need no DB queries.

steps.action: Invoke Run/Script/Stop/Run to File from toolbar/menu/keyboard while editor, grid, chooser and modal dialog have focus; switch document before delayed completion.
assertions: One command registry captures exact context.
focus/modal/busy gating is identical across entry points.

steps.action: Record/rebind/unbind/reset execution shortcuts, provoke duplicate/protected-key conflicts, restart, and load corrupt preferences; repeat under non-Latin layout/AltGr.
assertions: menus/toolbar/keyboard stay synchronized using native keys.

steps.action: Select System/Lager/Porter and named app scheme; select independent editor scheme/Follow App Appearance, preview and restart.
assertions: Preferences persist independently with safe fallback.
system changes update only following choices.

steps.action: Load bundled schemes and all shared imports including JSONC include/TextMate/JetBrains; delete source and reload; remove custom; test traversal/symlink/cycle/remote/XML entity/size attacks.
assertions: unsafe input is rejected and corrupt library preserved.

steps.action: During active editor Undo/selection/scroll, result selection and query execution, switch app/editor light/dark/system choices and render every dialog/popup/settings screen.
assertions: Live themes keep editing/execution state and readable text/icons/hover/focus/selection.
native light controls have correct contrast.

steps.action: Use native Open/Save/CA choosers and clipboard on Unicode/CRLF paths; type via IME/non-Latin/AltGr, move focus by keyboard, change fractional/mixed DPI and window bounds.
assertions: Desktop conventions and exact text survive.

steps.action: As standard user, create/read/update/delete a unique fixture credential in real native store; test missing/empty/locked/unavailable service and rollback failure.
assertions: Credential Manager/Secret Service roundtrip succeeds privately.
no plaintext fallback, unrelated credential access or loss of existing password.

steps.action: With Narrator/UIA or Orca/AT-SPI, navigate editor, virtualized grid, NULL/binary cells, inspector, menus, Settings and dialogs entirely by keyboard.
assertions: modal safe defaults and row/column position are operable.
rendering/headless tests do not substitute for this run.

steps.action: Launch exact packaged helper, check protocol/version and no Windows console; saturate stream, Stop, kill only owned helper and retry/recover.
assertions: helper death surfaces correct disconnected/unknown state.

steps.action: Inspect candidate GUI/helper version/build/icons/identity; migrate a copied prototype library and credentials; launch old/new simultaneously; independently rebuild Mac SwiftUI.
assertions: Stable identity retains IDs/credentials without data races.

steps.action: On clean standard-user desktops, verify archive/package checksum/notices/dependencies and signing/provenance policy, extract/install, launch without Go/Rust, then manually update.
assertions: Documented Windows runtime/Linux glibc/GPU/Secret Service requirements suffice.

steps.action: Install exact previous/candidate artifacts in an owned fixture; exercise repeated launch, preserve profiles/UUIDs/credentials/drafts/history/settings, restart/update/remove.
assertions: removal does not touch unrelated user data or processes.

steps.action: Run every required scenario on Windows 11 x64 and Ubuntu 24.04 x64 Wayland/X11 with PostgreSQL 16/17/18 and MySQL 8.0/8.4, TLS/fault/upgrade cases; audit summaries and skips.
assertions: Every native column has exact artifact/build/session/engine evidence and completed-run summary.

native_execution_policy.method: Execute listed actions against the exact GUI/PID with the native harness introduced in Task 2; retain per-assertion evidence and completed-run summary. Until then this is an executable Swift reference scenario plus a concrete native operator procedure.
extra_requirements: Native file/clipboard/IME and assistive technology where the scenario calls for them
native_execution_policy.acceptance_rule: All listed actions/assertions and platform-specific extensions must pass; reference-suite success never closes a native result.
